decision.original_text: 現在什麼情況，不要因為一個依賴有問題就停止工作，暫時強制降級、忽略漏洞或降低門檻以恢復工作，記錄這個漏洞，每日檢查一次是否有官方版本可更新

scope: Only this direct high advisory root and high meta findings whose reachable high/critical advisory roots exclusively equal it. Valid locked peer cycles must converge to identifiable roots; rootless/unknown graphs block. Low/moderate findings remain fully reported under the original high threshold and are not newly waived. Every critical or other high root blocks.
residual_risk: ReDoS risk is accepted temporarily, not fixed or fully excluded. Static toolchain-oriented evidence does not prove all runtime or attacker-controlled-pattern paths unreachable.
remove_when: An official applicable fix is available: review and update affected dependencies normally, remove this exception/helper routing, restore ordinary npm audit high behavior and pass the normal checks. Do not silently renew or widen the accepted advisory/lock scope.
revoke_now: Revert the security:audit script routing and remove the helper/exception record through the normal reviewed change and admission process.
unchanged: Dependency versions/lock, business cases/data, eight shards, global/per-file coverage floors, P1/P2 and other safety gates.
